story.title: The Great Tomato Launch
story.question: Can an overly enthusiastic inventor sell his automatic vegetable launcher at a busy morning market?
story.answer: Yes, by pivoting from a salad delivery device to an extremely loud morning wake-up service.

story_beats.headline: Tomato Catastrophe
story_beats.speech: Behold the glorious speed-peeler ninety-thousand! Watch as it expertly hurls a perfectly ripe red tomato across the crowded square.
story_beats.label: The Launcher
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby stands behind a wooden cart in a sunlit outdoor market, holding a smoking metal lever with an excited expression while a flying tomato heads toward a merchant.

story_beats.headline: Angry Vendor
story_beats.speech: Your wonderful invention just smashed my entire pyramid of imported cheese! You must stop this madness before the health inspector arrives.
story_beats.label: The Stall
story_beats.visual_prompt: Madame Dupuis stands with hands on hips, yelling angrily at Barnaby across a messy cheese stall smeared with red tomato pulp under a blue canopy.

story_beats.headline: Quick Adjustment
story_beats.speech: Do not despair my frustrated friend! With a simple twist of this brass dial, we transform from messy lunch to punctual wake-up call.
story_beats.label: The Adjustment
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby frantically turns a large brass gear on the side of his mechanical device, adjusting the angle upward with a focused and determined smile.

story_beats.headline: Morning Glory
story_beats.speech: Rise and shine dear neighbors! Never sleep through dawn again when you have the loudest, freshest vegetable alarm clock in the district.
story_beats.label: The Success
story_beats.visual_prompt: Multiple market vendors cheer happily as a single tomato launches straight up into the air over the crowded market stalls, ringing a tiny brass bell at the apex.

story.central_conflict: Market stalls are being ruined by flying vine-ripe tomatoes.
story.decisive_choice: Repurposing the spring-loaded catapult into a dawn alarm clock.
story.resolution: Every vendor pre-orders the launcher to start their stalls on time.

visual_bible.style: Bright, colorful stop-motion puppet animation aesthetic with detailed textures and whimsical proportions.

characters.Barnaby: An eccentric inventor with wild ginger hair, round wire-rimmed glasses, a patched green vest, and oil-stained trousers.
characters.Madame Dupuis: A stern market vendor wearing a tall white chef hat, a blue apron, and an expression of constant disapproval.

locations.Market Square: A bustling cobblestone town square lined with wooden stalls, colorful striped awnings, and woven baskets filled with fresh produce.

objects.Tomato Launcher: A complex brass and wooden contraption featuring large steel springs, leather straps, a spinning gear assembly, and a polished metal launching spoon.

story.title: Frostline Breach
story.question: Should Dr. Vance abandon the automated weather core to save the trapped supply sled?
story.answer: Dr. Vance abandons the core, deploying the thermal beacons to rescue the crew and securing the vital medical supplies.

story_beats.headline: The Overheating Core
story_beats.speech: The thermal arrays are failing fast. If we do not vent the reactor core right now, the whole station will melt.
story_beats.label: Thermal Warning
story_beats.visual_prompt: Dr. Vance stands inside the glowing red control room, pointing a trembling gloved finger at the flashing amber radar signal on the central console.

story_beats.headline: The Sled in Peril
story_beats.speech: Listen to that distress frequency! The crevasse is opening up beneath the transport sled and the cargo is sliding.
story_beats.label: Distress Call
story_beats.visual_prompt: Dr. Vance gazes through the frost-rimed window at the distant red tracked transport vehicle teetering precariously on the edge of a deep blue ice chasm.

story_beats.headline: The Hard Choice
story_beats.speech: We cannot save both the station data and our friends. I am cutting power to the core to run the heavy winch.
story_beats.label: Winch Activation
story_beats.visual_prompt: Dr. Vance slams down a heavy brass lever on the steel control panel, watching the automated mechanical winch arm swing outward into the blinding blizzard.

story_beats.headline: Safe Haven
story_beats.speech: The sled is aboard the safe ridge! We lost the research, but everyone is alive and warm tonight.
story_beats.label: Successful Rescue
story_beats.visual_prompt: Dr. Vance and two rescued researchers smile tiredly inside the brightly lit emergency shelter, holding steaming metal mugs of hot tea while the storm howls outside.

story.central_conflict: A sudden glacial fissure threatens to swallow the expedition supply sled while the main research core is overheating.
story.decisive_choice: Dr. Vance switches off the core cooling system to divert emergency power into the rescue winch.
story.resolution: The crew and supplies are hauled to safety just as the automated core goes offline permanently.

visual_bible.style: Cinematic gritty realism, cold blue and amber lighting, high contrast, detailed textures of frost, steel, and heavy winter gear.

characters.Dr. Vance: A seasoned arctic researcher with deep weathering on her cheeks, wearing a heavy orange parka with faux-fur hood and thick black thermal gloves.

locations.control_room: A cramped, utilitarian research outpost interior packed with blinking analog gauges, copper wiring, and frosted observation windows.

objects.brass_lever: A heavy, cold-to-the-touch brass switch mounted on a riveted steel plate connected to the station's main power grid.
objects.emergency_winch: A rugged, yellow-painted mechanical winch system rigged with thick steel cables and flashing safety strobes.

story.title: The Midnight Express Misplacement
story.question: Where did the missing cargo wagon of the 11:45 departure vanish?
story.answer: It was shunted onto an abandoned spur by an overly eager automated maintenance robot.

story_beats.headline: The Disappearance
story_beats.speech: Station master Clara stared at the empty tracks in absolute disbelief, wondering how an entire wagon vanished instantly.
story_beats.label: The Mystery
story_beats.visual_prompt: Station master Clara in a navy blue uniform stands on Platform Four under a flickering overhead light, staring at empty rails where a cargo wagon should be, holding a brass clipboard in her left hand.

story_beats.headline: The Mechanical Helper
story_beats.speech: A rusty maintenance robot rolled into view, holding a missing manifest scroll and beeping cheerfully to gain attention.
story_beats.label: The Clue
story_beats.visual_prompt: A compact, brass-plated maintenance robot with a single glowing blue optical lens rolls onto the wooden platform, holding a rolled parchment manifest in its mechanical gripper claw.

story_beats.headline: The Hidden Spur
story_beats.speech: Following the robot down into the dark tunnel, Clara discovered the missing wagon tucked safely on an overgrown side track.
story_beats.label: The Discovery
story_beats.visual_prompt: Clara and the maintenance robot stand before a heavy iron maintenance door inside a damp brick tunnel, pointing a lantern toward the forgotten spur track where the missing wooden wagon rests.

story_beats.headline: The Departure
story_beats.speech: With the tracks finally cleared by her unexpected helper, the midnight express whistled loudly and rolled out smoothly.
story_beats.label: The Success
story_beats.visual_prompt: Clara waves a green signal lantern on Platform Four as a steam locomotive with polished brass fittings pulls away into the night, while the small maintenance robot waves a metallic hand goodbye.

story.central_conflict: A misplaced cargo wagon blocks the express departure track.
story.decisive_choice: Reprogram the rogue maintenance automaton to clear the track.
story.resolution: The express departs safely with all cargo intact.

visual_bible.style: Cinematic Victorian railway mystery with warm golden lighting and moody shadows

characters.Clara: A meticulous station master with graying hair tied in a neat bun, wearing a tailored navy blue uniform with brass buttons and round spectacles.
characters.Unit-Seven: A squat, bipedal maintenance automaton constructed from riveted copper plates, featuring a single vibrant blue optical lens for an eye and jointed mechanical claws.

locations.Platform_Four: A bustling nineteenth-century railway platform featuring polished dark wood flooring, wrought-iron support pillars, and arched glass roofing panels.
locations.Tunnel_Spur: A damp, curved subterranean brick tunnel lit by flickering gas lamps, housing overgrown tracks and heavy cast-iron maintenance doors.

objects.Brass_Clipboard: A rectangular polished brass board holding a thick stack of railway departure schedules and white parchment notes.
objects.Signal_Lantern: A handheld black iron lantern with thick glass panes emitting a bright emerald-green glow when activated.
